page_title: GET 1-0 ELC | Getafe v Elche 28/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Elche comes to nothing.
90+6' David Affengruber (Elche) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the roof of the net, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert David Soria. What a save!

90+5' What a poor attempt! Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
90+4' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) sends a cross into the box, but David Soria comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The substitution has been made. Yvan Neyou (Getafe) has replaced Borja Mayoral.
89' The foul by Adria Pedrosa (Elche) was seen by Alejandro Hernandez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
87' Dangerous play by Luis Milla (Getafe). Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
86' Marc Aguado (Elche) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
84' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 5:3.

81' The opposition give Borja Mayoral (Getafe) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
80' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Kiko Femenia is replaced by Javier Munoz (Getafe).
80' That will be all from Alex Sancris who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Abu Kamara (Getafe).
78' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Djene (Getafe) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
77' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
75' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but David Soria is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
73' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
72' It will be a substitution. Yago Santiago (Elche) is ready to enter the pitch as German Valera walks off.
71' Here is a change. Andre Silva is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Rafa Mir (Elche).
69' Andre Silva (Elche) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
68' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Alex Sancris (Getafe) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Inaki Pena was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
65' Today's match ends for Allan Nyom who will be replaced by Diego Rico (Getafe).
64' Hector Fort is substituted due to injury. Eder Sarabia gives a chance to Adria Pedrosa (Elche).
61' Eder Sarabia decides to make a substitution. Martim Neto will be replaced by Marc Aguado (Elche).
59' Getafe string together a series of short passes.
56' 1 - 0 Goal! Kiko Femenia picks out Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom left corner with a header from close range. 1:0.
54' A pass from Kiko Femenia (Getafe) is intercepted by Inaki Pena and the move breaks down.
52' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
50' Getafe are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
48' The attendance is 7697.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
46' Substitution. Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) has come on for Grady Diangana.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Grady Diangana (Elche) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
43' Luis Milla (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
42' 32:68 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
39' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
39' Elche work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

38' Hector Fort (Elche) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but David Soria has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out for a corner. Elche can continue in their attacking effort.
36' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
35' Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight and sees a foul from German Valera (Elche).
33' Elche take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
33' Martim Neto (Elche) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Now Elche have a corner.
31' Grady Diangana (Elche) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
30' A quickly taken corner by Elche.
29' Andre Silva (Elche) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Elche will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
27' The Elche players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
25' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
23' Alex Sancris (Getafe) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

22' Good chance! Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
20' Elche control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

18' Allan Nyom (Getafe) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom right corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
17' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
16' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Adrian Liso (Getafe) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Getafe earn a corner.
15' Djene (Getafe) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
12' Andre Silva (Elche) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Hernandez no option but to blow his whistle.
10' Elche hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Alex Sancris (Getafe) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
6' Leo Petrot (Elche) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Alejandro Hernandez signals. Getafe have a free kick from a promising distance.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
5' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is out of play. Getafe win a corner kick.
3' Alex Sancris (Getafe) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Getafe will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez will officiate today.
